entries.def:
κοπετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόπτω, mid.), [in LXX chiefly for מִסְפֵּד ;] 
= cl. κομμός, a beating of the head and breast, lamentation: before ἐπί with dative of person(s), Act.8.2.†
(AS)

κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(κόπτω), [in LXX: Gen.14.17, Jos.10.20 (נָכָה hi., מַכָּה), Deu.28.25 (נָגַף), Jdt.15.7 * ;] 
__1. in cl., a stroke, a pounding (as in a mortar). 
__2. In LXX, a smiting in battle: Heb.7.1 (LXX).†
(AS)

κοπιάω, -ῶ
(κόπος), [in LXX chiefly for יָגַע ;] 
__1. (as in cl.) to grow weary: Mat.11.28, Jhn.4.6, Rev.2.3 (cf. Isa.40.31). 
__2. Hence, in LXX and NT, to work with effort, to toil: absol., Mat.6.23, Luk.5.5; 12.27, Jhn.4.38, Act.20.35, 1Co.4.12, Eph.4.28, 2Ti.2.5; with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.4.38 frequently in Paul. Epp., of ministerial labour: 1Co.15.10; 16.16; before ἐν, Rom.16.12, 1Th.5.12 (see M, Th.,…

κόπος, -ου, ὁ
(κόπτω) [in LXX chiefly for עָמָל, also for אָוֶן, etc. ;] 
__1. a striking, beating (in Jer.45.3 = κοπετός) 
__2. laborious toil, trouble: Jhn.4.38, 1Co.3.8; 15.58, 1Th.3.5; κ. τ. ἀγάπης, 1Th.1.3 ἔργα καὶ κ., Rev.2.2 κ. καὶ μόχθος, 2Co.11.27, 1Th.2.9, 2Th.3.8; pl., ἐν κ., 2Co.6.5; 10.15; 11.23; ἐκ τ. κ., Rev.14.13 κόπονς (-ον) παρέχειν (in cl. more frequently π. πράγματα, πονον), with dative of…

κοπρία, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for אַשְׁפֹּת ;] 
a dung hill (1Ki.2.8, Psa.113.7 al.): Luk.14.35.†
κόπριον, -ου, τό, 
[in LXX (pl.): Jer.25.33 (דֹּמֶן), Sir.22.2, 1Ma.2.62 * ;] 
= κόπρος, dung: pl., Luk.13.8 (WH, mg., κόφινον κοπρίων).†
(AS)

κόπτω 
[in LXX for כָּרַת, סָפַד, נָכָה hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to strike, smite. 
__2. to cut off: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Mat.21.8 ἐκ, Mrk.11.8. Mid., to beat one's breast with grief, to mourn, bewail: Mat.11.17; 24.30; with accusative of person(s), Luk.8.52; 23.27; before ἐπί, with accusative, Rev.1.7; 18.9 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐν-, κατα-, προ-, προσ-κόπτω).†
SYN.: θρηνέω, q.v (AS)

κόραξ, -ακος, ὁ 
[in LXX for עֹרֵב ;] 
a raven: Luk.12.24.†
(AS)

κοράσιον, -ου, τό 
(dimin. of κόρη), [in LXX chiefly for נַעֲרָה, Rut.2.8, al.; in Jol.4.3, Zec.8.5 for יַלְדָּה ;] 
a colloquial word which survives in MGr. (Kennedy, Sourcs, e154), girl, maiden: Mat.9.24-25; 14.11, Mrk.5.41-42; 6.22, 28.†
(AS)

κορβάν (Rec., T, -βᾶν), indecl. (Heb. קׇרְבָּן), 
an offering, a gift offered to God: Mrk.7.11 (cf. κορβανᾶς).†
(AS)

Κορέ indecl. 
(in FlJ, -έου), ὁ (Heb. קֶרַח) 
Korah: Jude.11.†
(AS)
